title: SURVEYING ATTITUDINAL ALIGNMENT BETWEEN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VS. HUMANS TOWARDS 17 SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS
findings: LLMs may fail to fully account for local religious beliefs, customs, and the role of faith-based networks when analyzing issues like poverty, unlike human approaches which can consider these factors. A cited study found that large language models associate Muslims with violence.
